svg.metadata: {"story":"Ruth","act":6,"chapter":"Ch.6 · At the Gate","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Boaz sits at the city gate with the elders, and the nearer kinsman is asked to redeem; he refuses, and Boaz takes Ruth.
